thread:
jules (Marketing): Quick sync: sprinting a compact battlecard pack for next week's launch. Need: 3 competitor buckets (cloud AI, public LLM APIs, infra vendors), 2 x SDR scripts each, and a short social + webinar hero.
ben (PR): Good call. Keep the public lines crisp. We should avoid hard benchmarking claims in PR, but we can say customer-observed improvements and link to a technical appendix.
sophia (Field): Field intel: prospects love simple econ soundbites. Also, for infra vendors they argue \"we control everything\". Counter: ops cost + unpredictable tail latency.
mike (Sales Enablement): I'll draft SDR 30s scripts. Example cold opener for cloud AI skeptics: \"Hey, quick Q: are you seeing hidden surcharges on model-heavy paths? Redwood surfaces unit economics so you can predict spend. 15 mins to show a sample runbook?\"
jules (Marketing): Love that. Now micro-rebut lines (one-liners):
- vs cloud AI: \"Transparent unit economics; fallback policies that keep apps healthy.\"
- vs LLM APIs: \"Consistent runtime and deployment flexibility, not just model access.\"
- vs infra vendors: \"Predictable performance without hiring a full ops team.\"
ben (PR): For social: two hero variants:
- Pragmatic: \"Cut token bills, keep output quality. Join our webinar.\"
- Engineer: \"Same API across hosted, dedicated, and private. See it live.\"
sophia (Field): For objection handling cheat: quick flow:
Prospect: \"We host models ourselves\" -> Ask: \"How many FTEs on ops? What's your p99 tail?\" -> If ops heavy, offer dedicated trial + cost model.

mike (Sales Enablement): Adding SDR scripts (short):
1) Cold email subject: \"Reduce inference surprises\" body: 2 lines + CTA demo.
2) Reply play: prospect says \"we use cloud vendor X\" -> Reply: \"Totally. Many customers pair X with Redwood to standardize SLAs and routing. Can I show a side-by-side?\"

jules (Marketing): Routing snippet for Intercom / Hubspot agents (copyable):
```
intent_rules:
  - keyword: "compliance"
    route: "private-sales-deck"
  - keyword: "price" 
    route: "benchmark-blog"
  - keyword: "self-host" 
    route: "dedicated-trial"
  - keyword: "latency"
    route: "perf-demo"
```

ben (PR): We'll phrase the launch post like: \"Engineering-grade inference that scales from proof-of-concept to SLA-backed production. Register for benchmarks and a live demo.\" Keep it under 120 chars for syndication.
sophia (Field): Add one field example for infra vendors to the battlecard: a case where stitching three vendor SDKs increased incident MTTR. Short bullet.
mike (Sales Enablement): I'll pair each competitor bucket with 2 customer-question prompts the SDR can use. e.g., \"What model sizes do you run most?\" and \"Do you have bursty periods?\"
build-bot: Deck uploaded -> https://drive.redwood/webinar/launch-pack-v1 (permission: marketing + sales)
jules (Marketing): Action items: 1) @mike: SDR scripts + QA matrix (EOD). 2) @sophia: 3 field bullets/examples (tomorrow AM). 3) @ben: final PR-safe hero line (EOD). 4) @jules: assemble pack + route to #sales-assets. We'll review Friday 10:00 PT. Short thread only, followup updates as replies here. :sparkles:
